description: The files and folders the node will serve, found by words (q; any order, matched against each name and path and ranked best first; empty means everything, in path order), as a bounded list of {key: path, label: path}; a folder's path ends in a slash. With contents: "yes" the words are also searched inside text files up to 1 MB (case ignored), and every label is {path, line, text}: the first matching line number and that line, or line 0 and no text for a match by name only.
